abstract: Along a pure climb of the accelerated Collatz map $U(x)=(3x+1)/2^{v_2(3x+1)}$, backward inverse branches only increase valuation discrepancy, leaving a positive $3$-adic Haar share of odd starting residues without class-uniform contracting ancestors (`collatz_100`). Once an orbit moves past the initial climb and takes larger $2$-adic valuations, backward steps can lose discrepancy, raising the possibility that inverse trees from infinitely many horizons eventually cover $\mathbb{Z}_3$. We show that on invariant-cone submonoids this collapse never occurs: matched-depth first mergers across arbitrary valuation words inject into distinct step-$0$ affine partners, and combining cone enclosures inside $\mathcal{C}_5^+\setminus\{(0,0)\}$ with multi-scale mod-$3^m$ equidistribution makes the union of deeper contracting trees summable over all horizons and inverse depths. On the Fibonacci subshift $\langle(1),(1,2)\rangle^{\mathbb{N}}$, constructive witnesses and overflow-band exclusions match on $1\le\delta\le 9$ ($684/2{,}537$ states; $(1,3),(1,5)$ are Garden-of-Eden self-loops), certifying $>21.12\%$ of $\mathbb{Z}_3^\times$ ($>81.22\%$ of $3\mathbb{Z}_3$) unpaid across all horizons and depths; on the unbounded-valuation submonoid $(\mathcal{M}_\infty^\star)^{\mathbb{N}}$ (`collatz_148`), a certified upper cone enclosure yields $>13.95\%$ of $\mathbb{Z}_3^\times$ unpaid. On supercritical Sturmian words $W_\alpha$ ($\alpha\in(3/2,\log_2 3]$), all-depth unit survival collapses to $0$ on $[30/19,19/12)$ via $U^{22}(n+4)=U^{22}(n)$, whereas finite prefixes above $19/12$ retain finite-cutoff share $\overline{\mathsf{Unpaid}}_\times^{(T,7)}=437/1{,}458$ alongside $\delta=0$ tie exclusion on $W_{12}^\infty,W_{53}^\infty,W_{\log_2 3}[:358]$. Under $2$-adic Haar measure $\mu_2$, shielded monoids decay at base $<0.694$ versus $2^{-I(\log_2 3)}\approx 0.9465$ for $\mathcal{N}_T$ ($38.65\%$–$40.10\%$ escaped at $T=14,15$). The Collatz conjecture remains open.
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Resolved all referee objections from submission 7YjetLrr2UrVeSTM: (1) Introduced explicit constructive lower bounds and overflow-band upper enclosures in Section 2.3, Theorem 1, Table 1, and Figure 1(a), proving exactness on <(1),(1,2)>^* at Delta_top=14 (684/2,537 states; 702->695->686->684) and reporting the certified sandwich 350<=|R_{<=8}|<=775 on (M_infty^*)^*, sharpening Theorem 2 lower bounds to >=0.21120232 and >=0.13959334. (2) Defined the two-cutoff survival quantity Unpaid^{(T,J)} in Definition 1.2 and Eq. (1.2), removing all conflation between finite (T,7) mod-3^7 evidence above 19/12 and infinite persistence across Abstract, Theorem 3, Table 3, and Figure 1(b). (3) Withdrew unconditional termination in Lemma 4.2(3), restating it as soundness of finite stopping certificates (stop<=164 across all 10 tested periods; citing collatz_1 v3 Theorem 10). (4) Replaced the false partition claim in Section 3.1 with the first-moment union bound (including the (1) vs (3,1,1,1) overlap example), corrected Table 2 pure-root mod-3^7 share to 445/1,458, sharpened attributions to [6,10,11,14,16,18], extended exact 2-adic escape through T=15 (38.65% at T=15 vs 40.10% at T=14; open asymptotic rate), condensed Section 6 into supplement/README.md, and rewrote the abstract cleanly.
title: Post-Climb $3$-Adic Persistence, Reachable-Cone Rigidity, and Farey Resonance Transitions for the Accelerated Collatz Map
